newsitem.title: USA: U.S. opens ag trade office in Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: U.S. opens ag trade office in Indonesia.

text.p: The United States opened an agricultural trade office in Indonesia, an increasingly important market for U.S. farm exports, Agriculture Department announced Monday.

"Throughout dynamic Asia, Indonesia has emerged as one of the fastest growing markets for U.S. agricultural products and is our eleventh largest overall," Gus Schumacher, head of the Foreign Agricultural Service, said in a statement.
U.S. farm exports to Indonesia totaled $908 million in fiscal 1996. Indonesia more than $2 billion in farm, forestry and fishery products to U.S. buyers in the same period.
Last week, a U.S. agricultural trade office was opened at the U.S. embassy in Hanoi.
